entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something? I bought some shoes a while ago, but I'm just so confused by everything. I don't know if I can, or what the policy is. It's all a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly look into that for you and help clear things up. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, let me see... I wrote it down somewhere... okay, here. It's VF90210-C.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro-Grade cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered to you 68 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is with them?

They just don't feel right. I tried to install the cleats, but it's so complicated. I wore them for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I just don't think they're for me. Can't you just help me? I'd really like to get a refund.
Of course, I can absolutely help with that. I'm sorry to hear the cycling shoes caused blisters. Let me just confirm our policy here... Yes, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So it's okay? That's such a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the box with the shoes and the cleats, and you can drop it off. Once we receive the items back at our warehouse, we'll process your full refund.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. That was much easier than I expected. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
